question: The Barren island is situated in the ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman Sea.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Barren Island:-**

 
 
• The Barren Island is an active volcano located in the Andaman Sea.
 
• It is the only active volcano in India and the entire South Asian region.
 
• The island is uninhabited due to the constant volcanic activity, and visitors are not allowed to land on the island.
